technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with bullish moving average alignment and exceptional volume spike, but extreme overbought conditions across multiple oscillators with declining momentum (RSI/Stoch not rising) create significant pullback risk and poor risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CDW shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 19 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed market sentiment (neutral AAII, moderate greed) with no recent news data provides insufficient basis for directional conviction on CDW.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (194.7) indicates extreme market stress, earnings event in 19 days adds binary risk; only falling DXY provides modest relief for IT multinational.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong uptrend structure (SMA 50/200 bullish, price above 200-SMA) with exceptional 15x volume spike provides technical foundation for continuation if overbought conditions resolve.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought across all oscillators (RSI-9/14, Stoch, Williams %R, UO) with declining momentum, zero fundamental catalysts, high earnings risk in 19 days, inverted yield curve, and VIX crisis levels create severe pullback risk with poor risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Not applicable — macro environment, earnings proximity, and extreme overbought conditions with declining momentum create unacceptable risk/reward.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 19 days combined with VIX crisis levels (194.7) and inverted yield curve create severe pullback risk; overbought oscillators with no rising momentum suggest imminent mean reversion.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Existing CDW position + 42 IT holdings already create sector concentration; avoid adding to risk during macro stress and earnings window.
